name: domotz-mcp
description: Every Domotz endpoint, plus a local SQLite fleet mirror that answers cross-site questions.

domotz_api_key.title: DOMOTZ_API_KEY
domotz_api_key.description: Sets DOMOTZ_API_KEY for the Domotz MCP server. Get a credential from https://portal.domotz.com/portal/settings/services?selected_menu=api_keys.

domotz_region.title: DOMOTZ_REGION
domotz_region.description: Sets DOMOTZ_REGION for the endpoint template variable {region}.

domotz_base_url.title: Domotz API base URL
domotz_base_url.description: Full API base URL. Leave blank: the CLI builds it from DOMOTZ_REGION. Set it only to point at a different host.

domotz_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
domotz_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.
